mutations.because: PT-8c item 1, F6: the report row keeps the legacy file's revision only when the store is given the file's exact bytes, because the revision is the SHA-256 of the payload. Re-serialising the parsed JSON drops the file's own whitespace, so a hand-formatted report is stored under another revision and as other bytes. The test imports a report with non-canonical whitespace and compares the stored revision with the SHA-256 of the source bytes.
command: a report is stored with the file's exact bytes, so its revision is the sha256 of the source
